manifestSchema.title: MobSimLab plugin manifest (mobsimlab-plugin.json)
manifestSchema.description: What a plugin contributes to MobSimLab (ADR-0036 §2 and §3). Producer: plugin authors; the bundled plugins live in plugins/. Consumer: tools/plugins/check.py (validation and the web app's generated registry, apps/web/src/plugins/bundled.generated.json), later the install flow. Plugin API major version 1. Bundled plugins may also add project tabs (`tabs`). Contribution points that are not built yet (checks, engines, schematics, panels, kpis) are reserved: the schema accepts no entries for them yet.

id.description: Reverse-DNS id; everything the plugin contributes is addressed as <id>/<item id>.

dataLicense.description: SPDX licence of the data contributions; must allow bundling into .mslab exports.

mobsimlab.description: Range of MobSimLab versions, such as ">=0.1 <1".

bundled.description: Ships with the MobSimLab image and is signed with the release key (ADR-0036 §8).

modes.description: Transport modes; each file follows plugin-mode.schema.json.

contexts.description: New assumption context keys with their options (ADR-0018), such as ropeway_system.

parameters.description: Assumption library entries (assumptions/README.md format), each with sources and a global fallback.

sources.description: Source register entries used by the plugin's parameters and vehicles.

vehicles.description: Folders of vehicle files per vehicles/schema (ADR-0026).

tools.description: Authoring tools for the Create tab: a core authoring kit with the modes it draws.

calculations.description: Calculations over the project's network (ADR-0036 §3). Until the sandboxed plugin host exists (Phase 2), only bundled plugins may contribute them, with runtime `bundled-wasm`: the code is a core crate compiled to WebAssembly (tools/wasm/build-<module>.sh, loaded from apps/web/src/wasm/<module>), released and reviewed with MobSimLab. Third-party `component` calculations come with Phase 2.

where.description: Where the app offers it: live while drawing in a tool, on demand in the GIS tab (maps over the whole project), in the Tables tab (tables over the whole project), or in Analysis. `plugin-tab`: in a tab the plugin contributes (`tabs`).

importers.description: Converters from a file format into a published contract (ADR-0036 §3), offered where the contract is used.

exporters.description: Converters from a published contract into a file format (ADR-0036 §3), offered where the contract is used.

mapLayers.description: Map layers drawn from a calculation's output with a MapLibre style (subset) file.

tabs.description: Project tabs after the core ones (Simulator … Preferences). Until the UI tier exists (ADR-0036 §6), only bundled plugins may contribute tabs: `view` names a view built into the web app (apps/web/src/features/<view>), reviewed and released with MobSimLab, and the tab shows the plugin's own calculations.

extensions.description: File name endings the app offers, such as .zip.

contract.description: The published contract read or written.

function.description: Exported function of the module: JSON in, JSON out.

maxBytes.description: Largest file the app passes in (import) or may write (export).

reserved.description: Contribution point of a later phase of ADR-0036; no entries are accepted yet.

modeSchema.title: MobSimLab transport mode contributed by a plugin
modeSchema.description: One entry of a plugin's `modes` contribution point (ADR-0036 §3). Producer: plugin authors. Consumer: tools/plugins/check.py, the web app's mode and tool registry, the published timetable (`mode`, GTFS route_type).

id.description: Mode id, unique across the core and all plugins.

kit.description: Core authoring kit that draws the mode.

operation.description: frequency: a belt of vehicles with no timetable; shuttle: vehicles reverse between two ends; timetabled: exact trips; on_demand: vehicles answer ride requests inside a zone.

contextKey.description: Assumption context key whose option picks the system or vessel type.

contexts.description: Options of contextKey this mode uses.

parameterPrefix.description: Prefix of the plugin parameters that feed the kit, such as `people_mover` for `people_mover.line_speed_ms`. Default: `ropeway` for the straight spans kit, `ferry` for the water route kit.

bundled.name: Cable cars
bundled.description: Urban ropeways: continuous gondolas (MGD, 2S, 3S, funitel, pulsed) and reversible aerial tramways, drawn with the straight spans kit (ADR-0037).

tools.label: Cable car
tools.hint: Gondolas and aerial tramways: click stations, towers follow.

ropeway.max_station_angle_deg.label: Direction change in a station, maximum

ropeway.min_clearance_m.label: Clearance under the loaded cabin, minimum

ropeway.recommended_clearance_m.label: Clearance under the loaded cabin, recommended

ropeway.sag_ratio.label: Rope sag under load, share of span

ropeway.terminal_dwell_s.label: Boarding time at an aerial tramway terminal

ropeway.reserve_share.label: Spare cabins, share of cabins on the line

ropeway.wind_slow_kmh.label: Wind speed at which the line slows down

ropeway.wind_stop_kmh.label: Wind speed at which the line stops

bundled.name: Cargo bike
bundled.description: How far an electric cargo tricycle gets out and back on one battery charge, over the hills and preferring bike lanes, and what it saves against a car (purchase, fuel, tax, insurance, parking, maintenance), in its own tab.

calculations.label: Cargo bike range
calculations.description: Round trip from a start point to a destination on bike-usable streets (preferring bike lanes) with the battery used over the terrain, and a range map of how far the bike gets out and back in every direction.

calculations.label: Cargo bike savings
calculations.description: Yearly cost of the cargo bike against a car for the same trips: purchase, energy, tax, insurance, parking and maintenance, in the currency of the start point's country.

style._comment: The range map (area reachable out and back on one charge), the trip there and back coloured by the kind of street, the bike-lane gap picked in the tab, and the charging points and bike parkings along the route. Class ids come from crates/cargo-bike (Class), amenity kinds from the API's bike-amenity tiles.

cargo_bike.assist_share.label: Share of the pedalling power the motor gives

cargo_bike.speed_separated_kmh.label: Cruising speed on a separated cycle track or cycle path

cargo_bike.speed_lane_kmh.label: Cruising speed in a painted bike lane

cargo_bike.speed_quiet_kmh.label: Cruising speed on quiet streets without a bike lane

cargo_bike.speed_mixed_kmh.label: Cruising speed in main-road traffic without a bike lane

cargo_bike.stops_per_km_separated.label: Stops per km on separated cycle tracks

cargo_bike.stops_per_km_lane.label: Stops per km in painted bike lanes

cargo_bike.stops_per_km_quiet.label: Stops per km on quiet streets

cargo_bike.stops_per_km_mixed.label: Stops per km in main-road traffic

cargo_bike.signal_stop_share.label: Share of traffic signals that stop the bike

cargo_bike.route_factor_separated.label: Route choice weight: separated cycle track

cargo_bike.route_factor_lane.label: Route choice weight: painted bike lane

cargo_bike.route_factor_mixed.label: Route choice weight: main road without bike lane

cargo_bike.detour_factor.label: Street distance over straight-line distance (range map)

cargo_bike.savings.bike_maintenance_eur.label: Cargo bike maintenance per year (2024 EUR)

cargo_bike.savings.bike_insurance_eur.label: Cargo bike insurance per year (2024 EUR)

cargo_bike.savings.car_residual_share.label: Car resale value at the end, share of the price

cargo_bike.savings.car_maintenance_eur_k.label: Car maintenance and tyres per km (2024 EUR)

cargo_bike.savings.fuel_co2_kg_l.label: Car CO₂ per litre of petrol (well to wheel)

cargo_bike.savings.grid_co2_kg_kwh.label: CO₂ per kWh of mains electricity

cargo_bike.savings.rider_efficiency.label: Rider's gross efficiency (pedalling energy per food energy)

bundled.name: Energy and emissions
bundled.description: Traction energy and greenhouse gas emissions of every line a year, per mode and for the network, from the vehicle-km each line runs: electricity at the substation or charger, diesel in litres, and CO2e from the grid's emission intensity and diesel well-to-wheel. Shown in the Tables tab.

calculations.label: Energy and emissions
calculations.description: Electricity, diesel, final energy and CO2e a year per line, per mode and for the network, with the intensity per vehicle-km and per place-km.

energy.electric_share.label: Share of vehicle-km run on electricity

energy.charging_loss_share.label: Charging loss, share of the energy taken from the battery

bundled.name: Ferries
bundled.description: Passenger ferries and water buses drawn with the water route kit: piers with berths and gangways, routes over water, speed zones and a berth check (ADR-0037). Car ferries come later.

tools.label: Ferry
tools.hint: Water buses and crossings: click piers, shape the route over water.

ferry.harbour_speed_kn.label: Speed limit in a new speed zone

ferry.layover_s.label: Layover at the ends of a line, minimum

ferry.pax_per_call_share.label: Passengers on and off at the busiest call, share of capacity

bundled.name: GTFS import and export
bundled.description: Reads a GTFS feed (zip) into the project as an existing network for one service day, cut to the map view if asked, so the journey planner rides it with the planned lines; and writes the project's lines as a GTFS feed for other tools.

importers.label: GTFS feed
importers.description: Stops, routes and the trips of one service day (the busiest Wednesday unless a date is given), with frequencies.txt as frequency patterns and route types as modes.

exporters.label: GTFS feed
exporters.description: The project's lines as a weekday GTFS feed: exact trips, frequency lines as frequencies.txt, stations for stop groups.

bundled.name: Noise map
bundled.description: Estimated noise of the service lines (ADR-0038): a live noise band while drawing street lines and railways, with checks for curve squeal, bridges and switches. CNOSSOS-EU road and railway emission, free field without buildings for now.

calculations.label: Noise band
calculations.description: L_den and L_night of the drawn lines at 4 m, free field: band distances either side, a receiver grid for the map and checks.

style._comment: The noise band is drawn as a picture of the receiver grid (raster), coloured in 5 dB bands after ISO 1996-2 / DIN 45682. Colours are applied by the engine (noise::band_colour); this layer sets how the picture is shown.

noise.band_lden_db.label: Noise corridor edge in the editors, L_den

noise.band_lnight_db.label: Noise corridor edge in the editors, L_night

noise.ground_factor_default.label: Ground factor G where land use is unknown (0 hard, 1 soft)

noise.building_storey_height_m.label: Height of one storey, for OSM buildings tagged with storeys only

noise.building_default_height_m.label: Height of an OSM building with neither height nor storeys

noise.favourable_probability_day.label: Share of favourable propagation conditions, day

noise.favourable_probability_evening.label: Share of favourable propagation conditions, evening

noise.favourable_probability_night.label: Share of favourable propagation conditions, night

noise.reflection_max_distance_m.label: Farthest facade that reflects onto a receiver (full map)

noise.facade_reflection_coefficient.label: Share of sound energy a facade reflects

noise.terrain_filter_window_m.label: Width of what is taken out of the surface model as not ground

noise.floor_area_per_person_m2.label: Floor area per resident, for people counts from the building size

noise.population_min_footprint_m2.label: Smallest building footprint that may hold homes

noise.building_level_height_m.label: Storey height for buildings without a height

noise.rail_source_height_a_m.label: Rail source A height above the rail head (rolling, impact, squeal, bridge, low traction)

noise.rail_source_height_b_m.label: Rail source B height above the rail head (roof traction, pantograph, aerodynamic)

noise.rail_min_roughness_speed_kmh.label: Lowest speed used for the rail rolling noise roughness

noise.rail_aero_from_kmh.label: Speed above which aerodynamic noise is added

noise.rail_vehicle_length_m.label: Rail vehicle length used to count vehicles in a train

noise.rail_powered_vehicle_share.label: Share of rail vehicles that carry traction equipment (multiple units)

noise.rail_wheel_roughness.label: Wheel roughness by brake type (CNOSSOS-EU Table G-1)

noise.rail_rail_roughness.label: Rail roughness (CNOSSOS-EU Table G-1, as replaced by 2021/1226)

noise.rail_contact_filter.label: Contact filter by wheel load and diameter (CNOSSOS-EU Table G-2, as replaced by 2021/1226)

noise.rail_wheel_transfer.label: Wheel transfer function by wheel diameter (CNOSSOS-EU Table G-3)

noise.rail_track_transfer.label: Track transfer function by sleeper and rail pad (CNOSSOS-EU Table G-3, as replaced by 2021/1226)

noise.rail_bridge_transfer.label: Bridge transfer function (CNOSSOS-EU Table G-7, as replaced by 2021/1226)

noise.rail_impact_extent_m.label: Impact noise from a switch or joint: extent before and after it

noise.road_stop_zone_m.label: Acceleration and braking zone either side of a stop

noise.electric_road_propulsion_delta_db.label: Electric buses and trolleybuses: change to the propulsion noise term

noise.rail_squeal_r300_db.label: Curve squeal, railways, radius up to 300 m

noise.tram_squeal_r200_db.label: Curve squeal, trams, radius up to 200 m

noise.squeal_min_length_m.label: Shortest curve that gets the squeal correction

noise.tram_embedded_track_db.label: Trams on embedded street track: added to the track part of rolling noise

noise.cable_car_tower_lw_db.label: Cable car tower: sound power while cabins pass the sheaves

noise.cable_car_station_lw_db.label: Cable car station: sound power of drive, bullwheel and cabin handling

noise.ferry_cruise_lw_db.label: Ferry at cruise speed: sound power

noise.ferry_berth_lw_db.label: Ferry at the berth: sound power of engines, auxiliaries and ramp

bundled.name: On-demand bus
bundled.description: Demand-responsive transport drawn with the service zone kit: outline a zone, set the requests an hour, the fleet and the service hours, and get the vehicles needed, the average wait, ride and door-to-door time from continuous-approximation formulas. Simulate the day dispatches every booking trip by trip (ADR-0042). The zone shows in the journey planner.

tools.label: On-demand bus
tools.hint: Minibuses booked by app: outline the zone, set the fleet and hours.

drt.speed_kmh.label: Average driving speed in the zone

drt.stop_dwell_s.label: Time stopped for a pick-up or drop-off

drt.target_utilisation.label: Busy share of the fleet that keeps waits short

drt.pooling_detour_share.label: Extra ride time from sharing, over the direct trip

drt.max_wait_limit_s.label: Longest wait before a booking is turned away

drt.max_detour_share.label: Longest ride, share over the direct ride

drt.max_detour_fixed_s.label: Longest ride, fixed allowance over the direct ride

bundled.name: People movers
bundled.description: Cable-hauled automated people movers on an elevated guideway, drawn with the straight spans kit: shuttles with two trains, and pinched loops with detachable trains that stop in every station (ADR-0037 §7). Self-propelled people movers need the railway editor and come later.

options.label: Shuttle, two trains on a fixed rope

tools.label: People mover
tools.hint: Cable-hauled shuttles and loops on a guideway: click stations, piers follow.

people_mover.max_station_angle_deg.label: Direction change at a curve point, maximum

people_mover.tower_height_m.label: Running level above the ground on a pier, standard

people_mover.max_tower_height_m.label: Running level above the ground on a pier, maximum

people_mover.station_rope_height_m.label: Running level above the ground at a station

people_mover.cabin_hang_m.label: Running level to the underside of the guideway

people_mover.sag_ratio.label: Deflection of the guideway, share of span

people_mover.station_passage_s.label: Stop at a station, or acceleration and braking loss of a shuttle

people_mover.reserve_share.label: Spare trains, share of trains in service

people_mover.capacity_ceiling_pphpd.label: Capacity ceiling of any cable-hauled people mover
